name: Construction Crew
pitch: The child becomes foreman for a day and runs the big machines to build a brand-new playground for the whole town.
setting: Maple Junction, a friendly small town with an empty lot, a busy main street, and a hill perfect for a slide

supportingCast.name: Digby
supportingCast.look: big yellow excavator with friendly headlight eyes and a scoop like a smile

supportingCast.name: Rosie Rumble
supportingCast.look: construction worker with an orange hard hat, curly red hair, and a clipboard

supportingCast.name: Tumble
supportingCast.look: small red dump truck who loves to make the beep-beep backing-up sound

starters.title: The Playground Before the Rain
starters.idea: The crew must finish the new playground before the big rain arrives tomorrow, but the slide won't fit through the gate. Digby tries to dig wider and Tumble tries to squeeze through, and both fail. The child notices the slide can come apart in two pieces, the crew rebuilds it inside, and the town plays just as the first drops fall.

starters.title: The Missing Golden Bolt
starters.idea: Rosie Rumble's lucky golden bolt, the last piece of the town clock tower, rolls away. The crew searches the dirt pile and the cement mixer with no luck. The child remembers the sound it made, follows the 'clink' trail to a puddle, and the clock chimes for the first time.
